item.title: LogicGrid 11.1.2
item.description:
Fixes

  • Fixed the grid not coming back after swiping between full screen apps or spaces, especially on multi-monitor setups. It now recovers on its own without needing a relaunch.
  • Fixed the grid not updating on zoom for some setups where Logic is running in a language other than English.
  • Made the Get Help screenshot tool more reliable when Logic Pro is busy or unresponsive, so it can no longer freeze while trying to capture.
  • Changed the Settings keyboard shortcut to Control + Option + N to avoid a conflict with Logic Pro.
  • The grid now stays visible while Settings is open, so you can see your changes apply live as you adjust them.
